Definition: adverb from G5046; completely, i.e. (of hope) without wavering:--to the end.
BiblicalUsage: The word is completely, to the end, without wavering. Peter says to gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hope to the end is the whole of the Christian life in one phrase.
